attributes.title: Professional Development & Practice Summit 2027
attributes.summary:
The American Nurses Credentialing Center, a subsidiary of the American Nurses Association, holds its Professional Development & Practice Summit from April 17 to 20, 2027, in San Antonio, Texas. The summit is built for people who run accredited programs: nursing continuing professional development providers, practice transition and nurse residency programs, advanced practice provider fellowships and Joint Accreditation providers.

Registration includes more than 15 ANCC contact hours. Advance pricing is $959 for ANA members and $999 for other attendees while the limited advance allotment lasts; the standard rates are $999 and $1,049. The conference room block covers the San Antonio Marriott Rivercenter and the Marriott Riverwalk, which stand next to each other, and closes March 25, 2027.
